title: Chapter 74 Li'S Grocery Store
content:
Chapter 74 Li'S Grocery Store

Li's grocery store has three facades.

In the display window, there is a fine tiger-head knife. The sword shines under the refraction of the sun.

This looks like a powerful businessman.

As soon as I walked in, a shop assistant came to greet me.

"Welcome to our store, what do you need? We have weapons, blueprints, scrolls, everything. If you have materials that you want to exchange for money, we will also buy them."

The shop clerk looked at Wang Shuo and his entourage with their extraordinary aura, and secretly guessed that this might be a big customer, so he was very enthusiastic.

"I'll just take a look first." Wang Shuo glanced at the hall and said casually.

"Okay!"

"I would like to ask, is your guest a private player or a lord?" The store clerk observed carefully and was a little unsure, so he still asked.

"Oh! What's the difference?" Wang Shuo frowned and became wary.

"Don't misunderstand me. If you are a lord, I recommend you to go to our second floor. There are various bulk materials needed for territory construction. The first floor is mostly for weapons, supplies, etc. for mercenary players or gang players. resources.”

Wang Shuo thought for a while and said immediately: "Take me to the second floor."

"Dear distinguished guest, you are invited to the second floor. Our boss is waiting for you upstairs! However, your entourage, please wait downstairs."

After saying that, the shop assistant bent down towards the corridor.

Wang Shuo was a little worried and said in a deep voice: "I only bring one person with me, no problem!"

When the shop assistant was hesitating, a strong voice came from upstairs: "No problem, please come upstairs."

Wang Shuo was not polite and followed the store clerk up to the second floor.

The furnishings on the second floor are very different from those on the first floor, but much smaller. There is a coffee table in the middle by the window and a few simple wooden chairs placed next to the coffee table.

"How do you call this Lord? I am the owner of Li's Grocery Store, Li Youcai."

The middle-aged man in rich clothes was full of wealth, with a smile on his face and said enthusiastically to Wang Shuo.

"My surname is Wang." Wang Shuo also said with cupped hands.

"Lord Wang, I am a guest from afar. Please sit down and drink a cup of hot tea first. Let's chat slowly." Li Youcai glanced at a maid beside him.

After the maid came downstairs, she soon brought two cups of hot tea.

Seeing that Wang Shuo didn't make any move, he picked up the tea bowl and took a sip.

Seeing this, Wang Shuo also picked up the ceramic tea bowl and took a sip. Suddenly, the aroma of tea overflowed, filling his mouth with fragrance, and he felt very energetic.

Ayub, on the other hand, stood beside Wang Shuo with an expressionless face.

“What a great tea!”

Li Youcai showed a smile on his face and agreed: "This is our Lijiazhuang's unique spiritual tea. It has the effect of refreshing the mind. Long-term drinking will be of great help to the growth of mental power."

Wang Shuo was puzzled, where did this Lijiazhuang come from?

But at this time, he didn't ask any more questions.

Lijiazhuang is naturally in the outside world!

This businessman named Li Wancai came from Stormwind City and was the agent sent by the famous local Li Chamber of Commerce into the Great Sophora Territory this time.

Businessmen are chasing profits. Seeing that new areas are being created, they naturally want to get involved in advance and want a piece of the pie.

"I wonder, Lord Wang, what do you want to buy this time?" Li Wancai put down his tea bowl and asked calmly.

Although Li Wancai was unable to bring in enough supplies from outside the territory.

But he is familiar with the business process and naturally knows how to start business quickly.

In a very short period of time, one of the most popular shops in Nanshan Market was acquired.

"Boss Li, what do you have here? What I need is materials that can speed up the pace of territory construction."

"Then you have come to the right place when you come to me. I am not only responsible for selling items, but also collecting items on behalf of customers. All kinds of basic materials are very abundant, and large quantities are advantageous."

"That's really great."

"How do you sell the tung oil here?" Wang Shuo asked directly.

"Eight silver coins per unit. If you buy more, the price can be negotiated." Li Youcai said with a smile.

As soon as he finished speaking, there was a commotion downstairs.

Li Youcai's face darkened, he stood up, and was about to take a look down the stairs.

Who on earth is so blind and dares to act wild here?

At this moment, a group of people happened to rush in.
